advisories.basis: §7 defines Max Length as 'the recommended maximum length' and names its consumer — 'Network guards may use this value as a check to prevent data leaks' — so exceeding it breaks no 'shall' and the item is decoded. Recorded as an advisory rather than skipped, because applying ST 0601.13-29's requirement to a recommendation would enforce a rule the document did not write
